name: linkding
description: A bookmark manager with tags, full-text search and a browser extension. Its SQLite database lives in the data volume.

access.note: Sign in with the name you chose under "First user" and the generated password from the Variables tab. linkding creates that superuser the first time the container starts and leaves it alone on every later start.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: The address other people open. It is also the origin linkding trusts for the login form, so the form cannot be submitted without it.

inputs.name: admin-user
inputs.label: First user
inputs.description: Created on first start with the generated password.

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: Bookmarks, tags and the search index

update.notes: linkding migrates its database on start.

secrets.name: admin-password
secrets.label: First user's password
secrets.description: Reveal it from the Variables tab to sign in the first time.
